comment: The maker names no port. Panel names come from the rendered panel; the /1 to /16 and /A to /F labels sit below their jacks. src/controller/Gnome.cpp:58-59 comments that the tempo is rounded to a tenth, but the cast to uint16_t cuts it to a whole number. The two numeric displays are plain widgets with no parameter, so they cannot be clicked. The BPM and WIDTH jacks share their panel label with the knob beside them.
